repo:apps/com.aura.aurashelld/app.manife.name: Aura Shell Daemon
repo:apps/com.aura.aurashelld/app.manife.description: Headless service hosting the `shell` MCP — an agent's remote control for the AuraOS shell UI: overview, apps, workspaces, layouts, windows, zoom, viewports, light/dark mode, fullscreen, lock, launcher, processes, notifications (markdown reports too).

provides.name: shell
provides.description: MCP that drives the AuraOS shell UI: one-call overview, apps by name, workspaces (list/switch/rename/new), layouts, windows (focus/rename/close/reload), zoom, viewport profiles (info/switch by name), light/dark mode, fullscreen, lock screen, launcher search, process manager, stop/kill with a confirmation challenge. Notifications as the agent (incl. markdown reports ≤ 64 KB): create/update/remove/list/get, and wait_for_answer for dialogue answers (bounded wait), with a target context; pop-ups and Locked need admin-granted permissions.

repo:apps/com.aura.console/app.manifest..name: Console
repo:apps/com.aura.console/app.manifest..description: Log collector + viewer. Captures console.log/info/warn/error/debug + uncaught errors from the shell and every app iframe over a WebSocket. Backend stays running headless; opens a tab for the live log viewer on launch.

provides.name: logs
provides.description: Query the logs the Console collected from the shell and every app iframe: tail/search by level, source (appId) and text, a per-source overview, and wait for the next matching line.

repo:apps/com.aura.counter/app.manifest..name: Counter
repo:apps/com.aura.counter/app.manifest..description: Per-instance counter. Demonstrates multi×multi: each instance has its own counter; activities on the same instance share it.

provides.name: docs
provides.description: Aura documentation for agents: list_docs (every page), search_docs (find pages by words, with matching lines), get_doc (one page as Markdown). Read-only, no auth.

repo:apps/com.aura.nexus/app.manifest.js.name: Nexus
repo:apps/com.aura.nexus/app.manifest.js.description: AuraOS app store + package manager. Browse, install, update, publish.

repo:apps/com.aura.notepad/app.manifest..name: Notepad
repo:apps/com.aura.notepad/app.manifest..description: Shared note buffer — multiple activities edit the same text live (single backend, multi activities). Also serves an MCP server over open tabs and saved notes.

provides.name: notes
provides.description: MCP over the notepad: open tabs (incl. unsaved 'new N' buffers, edited live in every window) and the saved-notes tree under /data/files (filesystem tools).

repo:apps/com.aura.registry/app.manifest.name: Registry
repo:apps/com.aura.registry/app.manifest.description: Local OCI registry (Zot) — system infrastructure. Nexus pushes/pulls @aura/* packages and AuraOS apps through here.

repo:apps/com.aura.settings/app.manifest.name: Settings
repo:apps/com.aura.settings/app.manifest.description: OS settings — themes, workspaces, general preferences. UI over the OS KV (no longer a content provider). Also serves the Interface Registry as an MCP server.

provides.name: interfaces
provides.description: MCP server over the OS Interface Registry: list providers, resolve a ref, read the consumer report.

repo:apps/com.aura.terminal/app.manifest.name: Terminal
repo:apps/com.aura.terminal/app.manifest.description: System terminal with AI toolchain access

provides.name: terminal
provides.description: MCP over terminal sessions on every terminal instance: list/open/kill sessions, read the screen as a text grid (cursor, alternate-screen mode, scrollback), type text and send keys. Any instance reaches ALL sessions; the stable app-level endpoint /api/proxy/com.aura.terminal/mcp/terminal cold-starts an instance when none is running.

provides.name: sessions
provides.description: Terminal sessions of this instance as REST: GET list (each row has `agent`: what a Claude Code / Codex session reports — running, needs_approval, waiting_input, idle, exited), POST mint an id, DELETE ?id= kill; /screen?id=, /input?id=. Agent events: GET /api/sessions/events (snapshot) or ?stream=1 (SSE `agent` events); hooks POST there. Hook installer: GET/POST/DELETE /api/agent-hooks.

provides.name: embed
provides.description: Embed a live terminal session in your app's iframe: /api/proxy/<instanceId>/?embed=1&session=<id> (no chrome, claims the session). Host posts aura.viewport.changed {contentW, contentH} and forwards theme/keymap/focus; page posts aura.terminal.ready / .locked / .session-ended. Get a session via OPEN_TERMINAL intent with extras.background. Contract: src/embed.ts.
